set(CORE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/fceumm/src)
set(COMMON ${CORE}/drivers/libretro/libretro-common)
file(GLOB BOARDS CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${CORE}/boards/*.c ${CORE}/input/*.c)
set(SOURCES ${BOARDS} ${CORE}/drivers/libretro/libretro.c ${CORE}/drivers/libretro/libretro_dipswitch.c)
foreach(NAME cart cheat crc32 fceu-endian fceu-memory fceu fds fds_apu file filter general input md5 nsf palette ppu sound state video vsuni ines unif x6502)
 list(APPEND SOURCES ${CORE}/${NAME}.c)
endforeach()
foreach(NAME streams/memory_stream compat/compat_posix_string compat/compat_snprintf compat/compat_strcasestr compat/compat_strl compat/fopen_utf8 encodings/encoding_utf file/file_path file/file_path_io streams/file_stream streams/file_stream_transforms string/stdstring time/rtime vfs/vfs_implementation)
 list(APPEND SOURCES ${COMMON}/${NAME}.c)
endforeach()
add_library(fceumm STATIC ${SOURCES})
target_compile_definitions(fceumm PUBLIC RETRO_API=)
target_include_directories(fceumm PUBLIC ${COMMON}/include PRIVATE ${CORE} ${CORE}/drivers/libretro ${CORE}/input ${CORE}/boards)
target_compile_definitions(fceumm PRIVATE __LIBRETRO__ PATH_MAX=1024 FCEU_VERSION_NUMERIC=9900 FRONTEND_SUPPORTS_RGB888)
if(MSVC)
 target_compile_definitions(fceumm PRIVATE INLINE=_inline _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
 target_compile_options(fceumm PRIVATE /utf-8 /wd4996 /std:c11)
else()
 target_link_libraries(fceumm PUBLIC m)
endif()
